package.name: CAM Addon
package.description: Makes FreeCAD CAM easier to use. Describe a machine as an assembly - axes, spindles, tool and workpiece mounts -, move its axes by hand and hand it to CAM. Tool manager with a material list, cutting data per material, a comparison of milling strategies and a planner for roughing values; hands tools, cutting data, step over and step down over to CAM and imports tools from CAM libraries.
